criteria.comparison: integer equality against the rebuilt index's calibration
criteria.statement: The submitted adjudication threshold is the one the built index calibrated.

criteria.comparison: integer equality against the rebuilt index
criteria.statement: The submission counts every colliding pair the built index holds.

criteria.comparison: set equality against the verifier's own adjudication
criteria.statement: The near-duplicate pair set is closed over duplicate groups and not a list of thresholded edges.

criteria.comparison: submitted pair count is greater than reference_value
criteria.statement: The answer exceeds the thresholded edge set, because grouping adds within-group pairs the threshold alone never joins.

criteria.comparison: pair equality against the verifier's own derivation
criteria.statement: The collision witness is the refused collision maximal by band count, then similarity, then lexicographic order.

criteria.comparison: the unsupported pair count is zero
criteria.statement: Not one submitted pair falls outside the verifier's own adjudication.
The adjudication covers every unordered pair of distinct records rather than only the index's candidates.

judged: the solution against its reference answer
